allowedPaths.description: Exact canonical source/configuration paths the task may inspect or preserve. A contract owner must be present here.

ownedPaths.description: Canonical source paths owned by this task's preservation or implementation boundary.

referencePaths.description: Read-only source/configuration inputs used to derive or verify the boundary.

generatedPaths.description: Disposable derived outputs that are never canonical architecture source.

forbiddenPaths.description: Paths the task must not treat as canonical writable inputs. Generated paths may be repeated here to forbid source classification.

architecturePreservationContract.description: Source-derived KEEP_EXISTING boundary for package, build-entry, composition-root, bootstrap, registration, and generated-output verification.
